data.turoyo: <...> qamayto, kombalti a msabbəq w bəṯr a mṭayəf, <...>
data.translation: <...> Zuerst reift die msabbǝq genannte Art heran, dann mṭāyif, <...>

rationale: Second Infectum context; early ripening ordered by named grape varieties, without repeating the full variety catalogue.

summary: Both ko- Infectum occurrences have grape-vine/variety subjects and no object. Retain the inherited II stem label although the attested valency is intransitive.
94/116 gives a developmental sequence;94/117 ranks varieties by ripening time. This does not establish different senses or a technical numbered subsense.
The inherited gloss includes Knospen ansetzen, but94/116 assigns the early budding stage to kombarṭmi and places kombalti later. Do not silently transfer a neighbouring verb's meaning to blt.
Only Infectum is attested here; the inherited Preterit base is preserved without constructing a new box.

What independent evidence supports the inherited Knospen ansetzen under blt? The supplied verse's blt event is ripening, while another verb expresses budding. Review before retaining or removing that gloss component.
